title: 泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環~Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields
focus: 追蹤泥水循環的壓力、固體與能量收支以及分離設備限制~Track pressure, solids and energy balances and separation limits in slurry circuits
summary: 本課聚焦追蹤泥水循環的壓力、固體與能量收支以及分離設備限制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on track pressure, solids and energy balances and separation limits in slurry circuits. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 循環系統與控制邊界~Circuit and control boundaries
units.title: 循環系統與控制邊界~Circuit and control boundaries
units.mechanism: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。 假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。~A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.
units.verify: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。~Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.
units.failure: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。~Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.
units.misconception: 送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。~The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.

units.anchor: 流速與顆粒輸送~Velocity and solids transport
units.title: 流速與顆粒輸送~Velocity and solids transport
units.mechanism: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。平均速度只是起點，彎頭和停流區可局部沉積，不能由一個管段速度保證整線暢通。 假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。~Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed.
units.verify: 對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。~Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.
units.failure: 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。~Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.
units.misconception: 單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。~Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄流速與顆粒輸送的資料來源與適用條件。對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for velocity and solids transport. Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.

units.anchor: 壓差與泵浦功率~Pressure loss and pump power
units.title: 壓差與泵浦功率~Pressure loss and pump power
units.mechanism: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。 假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。~Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses.
units.verify: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。~Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.
units.failure: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。~Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.
units.misconception: 馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。~Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄壓差與泵浦功率的資料來源與適用條件。同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure loss and pump power. Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.

units.anchor: 固體質量濃度~Solids mass concentration
units.title: 固體質量濃度~Solids mass concentration
units.mechanism: 泥水密度可估固體體積比例，但須知道液相與顆粒密度且無顯著氣體。質量濃度與體積濃度不同，分離效率與出土量換算使用不同基準時必須明確轉換。 假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。 把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。~Mixture density can estimate solids volume fraction if liquid and grain densities are known and gas is negligible. Mass and volume fractions differ, requiring explicit conversion when assessing separation or excavated-material quantities. Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271. Confusing volume and mass fractions misstates solids production, while gas reduces measured density and mimics dilution. The error propagates into separator loading and spoil-quantity forecasts.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271.
units.verify: 以密度計和乾燥固體取樣交叉核對，檢查含氣與顆粒密度差異；報告量測基準、溫度及取樣代表性，若密度推估與實測不符，先查氣體或液相添加而非強制調整土量。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。~Cross-check density with dried-solids sampling and investigate entrained gas and grain density; document basis, temperature and representativeness, resolving discrepancies before forcing density-derived excavation quantities to match expectations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing volume and mass fractions misstates solids production, while gas reduces measured density and mimics dilution. The error propagates into separator loading and spoil-quantity forecasts.
units.failure: 把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。~Confusing volume and mass fractions misstates solids production, while gas reduces measured density and mimics dilution. The error propagates into separator loading and spoil-quantity forecasts.
units.misconception: 泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。~The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄固體質量濃度的資料來源與適用條件。以密度計和乾燥固體取樣交叉核對，檢查含氣與顆粒密度差異；報告量測基準、溫度及取樣代表性，若密度推估與實測不符，先查氣體或液相添加而非強制調整土量。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for solids mass concentration. Cross-check density with dried-solids sampling and investigate entrained gas and grain density; document basis, temperature and representativeness, resolving discrepancies before forcing density-derived excavation quantities to match expectations.

units.anchor: 旋流分離與分級~Cyclone separation and grading
units.title: 旋流分離與分級~Cyclone separation and grading
units.mechanism: 旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。細顆粒仍可能隨底流走，粗粒也可能旁通，需用完整粒徑分配和質量收支描述效率。 假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。~Cyclones classify through particle inertia and flow, but cut size is not a perfect boundary. Fines can report to underflow and coarse particles can bypass, requiring size distributions and mass balance rather than one headline efficiency. For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size. Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology. Coarse recovery alone can miss a circuit medium drifting away from its required behavior.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size.
units.verify: 同時取進料、溢流與底流樣，做流量、濃度和粒徑收支，將粒徑分級效率分開；設備審查需確認採樣時間對齊及濕乾基準，不能只看一側看似乾淨。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。~Sample feed, overflow and underflow together and close flow, concentration and grading balances; review size-specific efficiency with synchronized wet-dry bases rather than judging one visually clean stream. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology. Coarse recovery alone can miss a circuit medium drifting away from its required behavior.
units.failure: 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。~Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology. Coarse recovery alone can miss a circuit medium drifting away from its required behavior.
units.misconception: 旋流器總回收率就是每個粒徑完全相同的分離率。~Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄旋流分離與分級的資料來源與適用條件。同時取進料、溢流與底流樣，做流量、濃度和粒徑收支，將粒徑分級效率分開；設備審查需確認採樣時間對齊及濕乾基準，不能只看一側看似乾淨。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cyclone separation and grading. Sample feed, overflow and underflow together and close flow, concentration and grading balances; review size-specific efficiency with synchronized wet-dry bases rather than judging one visually clean stream.

units.anchor: 槽位與停留時間~Tank levels and residence time
units.title: 槽位與停留時間~Tank levels and residence time
units.mechanism: 槽體提供緩衝與混合，但理想平均停留時間不代表每個顆粒停留相同。短流與死區使部分介質很快返回、部分長期沉積，槽位正常也可能掩蓋有效容積減少。 假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。~Tanks buffer and mix, but average residence time does not apply to every particle. Short circuits return some material rapidly while dead zones retain deposits, so normal level can conceal loss of effective volume. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution. Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution.
units.verify: 用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。~Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.
units.failure: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。~Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.
units.misconception: 槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。~Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄槽位與停留時間的資料來源與適用條件。用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tank levels and residence time. Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering.

units.anchor: 壓力暫態與管路彈性~Pressure transients and pipe elasticity
units.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性~Pressure transients and pipe elasticity
units.mechanism: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。 假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。~Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Entrained gas, non-Newtonian behavior and branches complicate a simple water-hammer relation, requiring a system analysis rather than one valve-side reading. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation.
units.verify: 以足夠頻率壓力紀錄對照流量事件，將實際管材、支承、含氣及閥件時序帶入專業暫態分析；任何控制變更由設備工程師核准，本課算式不得用來自行操作閥件。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。~Compare sufficiently fast pressure records with flow events and analyze actual pipe, supports, gas and valve timing professionally; equipment engineers approve changes, and this relation does not authorize valve operation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks.
units.failure: 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。~Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks.
units.misconception: 不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。~A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄壓力暫態與管路彈性的資料來源與適用條件。以足夠頻率壓力紀錄對照流量事件，將實際管材、支承、含氣及閥件時序帶入專業暫態分析；任何控制變更由設備工程師核准，本課算式不得用來自行操作閥件。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure transients and pipe elasticity. Compare sufficiently fast pressure records with flow events and analyze actual pipe, supports, gas and valve timing professionally; equipment engineers approve changes, and this relation does not authorize valve operation.

units.anchor: 磨耗與剩餘厚度~Wear and remaining thickness
units.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度~Wear and remaining thickness
units.mechanism: 固體顆粒撞擊與滑磨使管壁損失，彎頭外側和局部高速區可能先變薄。平均厚度不能代表最低剩餘壁厚，磨耗速率又隨粒徑與流況變化，必須把位置與歷程一起記錄。 假設某點厚度由12降10 mm歷時1000 h，平均磨耗0.002 mm/h；線性外推只在同工況下作情境比較。 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。~Particle impact and abrasion remove wall material, often fastest on outer bends or local high-speed zones. Mean thickness does not represent minimum wall, and changing grading and flow make wear rates time dependent. An assumed point thinning from 12 to 10 mm over 1000 h averages 0.002 mm/h; linear extrapolation is only a same-condition scenario. Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某點厚度由12降10 mm歷時1000 h，平均磨耗0.002 mm/h；線性外推只在同工況下作情境比較。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed point thinning from 12 to 10 mm over 1000 h averages 0.002 mm/h; linear extrapolation is only a same-condition scenario.
units.verify: 在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。~Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.
units.failure: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。~Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.
units.misconception: 管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。~Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄磨耗與剩餘厚度的資料來源與適用條件。在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for wear and remaining thickness. Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone.

units.anchor: 循環可靠度與備援~Circuit availability and redundancy
units.title: 循環可靠度與備援~Circuit availability and redundancy
units.mechanism: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。可靠度需考慮共用電力、閥件和分離容量，時間利用率則受預防維護與故障停機共同影響。 假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。~Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. Shared power, valves and separation capacity limit redundancy, while planned and unplanned downtime both affect availability. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability. Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability.
units.verify: 以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。~Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity.
units.failure: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。~Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity.
units.misconception: 兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。~Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄循環可靠度與備援的資料來源與適用條件。以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit availability and redundancy. Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation.

units.anchor: 泥水資料與工程結案~Slurry-data engineering closeout
units.title: 泥水資料與工程結案~Slurry-data engineering closeout
units.mechanism: 完整循環帳目讓地層變化、設備退化與處理效能可以回溯，資料只有單位一致並附感測器位置才可整合。結案須保留原始時間序列及校準，不以每班平均取代可能控制風險的暫態。 假設10個流量感測器中9個具完整校準鏈，追溯率90%；關鍵回流計缺失仍須個別處理。 只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。~Complete circuit accounting supports retrospective separation of geology, equipment degradation and treatment behavior. Integration requires consistent units and sensor locations. Retain raw time series and calibration rather than replacing important transients with shift averages. If 9 of an assumed 10 flowmeters have complete calibration chains, traceability is 90%; a missing critical return meter still requires individual resolution. Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個流量感測器中9個具完整校準鏈，追溯率90%；關鍵回流計缺失仍須個別處理。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 flowmeters have complete calibration chains, traceability is 90%; a missing critical return meter still requires individual resolution.
units.verify: 從一段出土體積追查送回流、密度、槽位與校準原檔，核對時鐘和取樣間隔；業主及設備負責人確認缺漏與剩餘限制後接管，不能用高整體完成率掩蓋關鍵通道缺資料。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。~Trace one excavation-volume interval to flow, density, levels and calibration, checking clocks and sample intervals; owner and equipment leads accept remaining gaps explicitly rather than allowing a high completion percentage to conceal missing critical channels. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history.
units.failure: 只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。~Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history.
units.misconception: 每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。~Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄泥水資料與工程結案的資料來源與適用條件。從一段出土體積追查送回流、密度、槽位與校準原檔，核對時鐘和取樣間隔；業主及設備負責人確認缺漏與剩餘限制後接管，不能用高整體完成率掩蓋關鍵通道缺資料。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for slurry-data engineering closeout. Trace one excavation-volume interval to flow, density, levels and calibration, checking clocks and sample intervals; owner and equipment leads accept remaining gaps explicitly rather than allowing a high completion percentage to conceal missing critical channels.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示追蹤泥水循環的壓力、固體與能量收支以及分離設備限制需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why track pressure, solids and energy balances and separation limits in slurry circuits requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.
教學量化備忘：假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed.
教學量化備忘：假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses.

教學量化備忘：假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271.

教學量化備忘：假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size.

教學量化備忘：假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。~Teaching quantitative note: With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution.
